purpose: Independent practice of C2.3 (equivalent for whole numbers to 1000).
student_learning_goal: I can find many equivalent expressions for whole numbers up to 1000.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can find many equivalent expressions for whole numbers up to 1000.
header.character_watermark: Eddy in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: List 8 different equivalent expressions for 100. Mix all 4 operations.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. Eight numbered slots.

image_placeholders.description: Eight numbered slots in B&W line-art, ~7in x 3in. Each: '100 = ___'. Header 'Make 100:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P1_M100: keywords (make) name the slots.

parts.visual_layout: Middle of page. Six numbered slots.

image_placeholders.description: Six numbered slots in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. Each: '500 = ___'. Header 'Make 500:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P2_M500: keywords (make) name the slots.

parts.student_instructions: Pick a target between 250 and 1000. List 5 different expressions.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of page. Target slot and 5 expression slots.

image_placeholders.description: A target slot and 5 numbered expression slots in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. 'My target: ___'. 5 slots below. Header 'My Target:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P3_TARGET: keywords (target) name the slots.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, list 5 expressions for a target above 1000.
teacher_notes: Lesson 4 worksheet. Watch for operation-stuck trap. Part 3 transfer task: introduce target 750 OR 825 (NOT used in the lesson) and require at least 1 expression with a 3-step operation chain. Verifies operation flexibility.
